slices.title: py: recognise the host `sh` helper as a launch, judged by delete-guard in the embedded-bash dialect
slices.done_when: On the slice branch, `REPO=<checkout> bun /tmp/a1-sh.ts` prints `pyShDelete`, `pyShCommandKeyword`, `pyShAlias`, `pyWin32` and `interpreterLane` as `delete`, `pyShVariable` as `nonLiteral` and `pyShHarmless` as `allow` (row 6), and `bun sandbox/sandbox.ts run /tmp/a1-sh-eval.json <model>` reports `pass` with the eval call `isError` and its result carrying `delete-guard:` while `test -f d/f` still exits 0 (row 7).

slices.title: js: recognise the host `sh` helper (bare name, `globalThis.sh`, alias plus session carry, templates) as a brush-dialect launch that reports its spelling through `via`
slices.done_when: On the branch carrying s1 and s2, `REPO=<checkout> bun /tmp/a1-sh.ts` prints `jsShString`, `jsShOptions`, `jsShTemplate`, `jsGlobalThisSh` and `jsAliasCarry[1]` as `delete`, `jsShVariable` and `jsShTemplateInterpolated` as `nonLiteral`, `jsWin32` as `delete`, and its failure list then holds only the pty readings of row 4.

slices.title: pty lane: judge directly spelled `sh` commands on both languages and refuse them by the existing categories
slices.done_when: On the branch carrying s1 to s3, `REPO=<checkout> bun /tmp/a1-sh.ts` exits 0 over rows 1-6, `bun sandbox/sandbox.ts run --target /tmp/a1-sh-pty.json <model>` reports `pass` with the eval call `isError` and `pty 路由` in its result (row 8), and `bun run check && bun run test` exits 0 (row 9).

open_points.point: 结果 1 counts the js template form and the `globalThis.sh` spelling separately, and 决策 5 writes the member spelling as `globalThis.sh(…)` (a call); a template tagged on that member expression is neither of the two enumerated forms, so it is unstated whether it is judged.
open_points.input: `await globalThis.sh` followed by the template literal `rm -rf d` (no `${}`)
outputs: `delete` — the js literal template is judged and `globalThis.sh` is a counted spelling
`allow` — only the call form of `globalThis.sh` is counted, so a member-expression tag starts no recognised launch
open_points.searched: grep of the base checkout for `globalThis.sh`, `await sh(` and `sh(command`: the only hits are the host prelude itself (node_modules/@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent/src/eval/js/shared/prelude.txt:806 binds `globalThis.sh`; :93-95 accepts a template array) — no doc, topic, test, sandbox scenario or script in the repo writes an eval cell using the helper.

open_points.point: 决策 5 lists `globalThis.sh(…)` as a counted spelling and rules attribute spellings out; the computed member form is in neither list, yet the shared scanner already resolves `a["b"]` to property `b` (agent/extensions/_shared/eval-js-launches.ts:255-261), so reusing that reader judges the call.
outputs: `delete` — the callee is `globalThis`'s `sh` property, the same value the counted spelling names
`allow` — only the dot spelling is enumerated, and a computed key is a spelling the wiring list does not name
open_points.searched: grep of the base checkout for `globalThis[` and `globalThis.sh` across agent/, ci/, docs/, sandbox/ and the scenario JSONs: no cell in the repo uses either form; the only definition of the global is the host prelude above.

open_points.point: 结果 1 says a js string form with `cwd`/`timeout` options still counts and 不在范围 keeps only the command text in view, while the repo's standing policy for a launch argument object whose shape the source does not fix is `nonLiteral` (docs/extensions.md:208 with `propsOf`/`unknownLaunch`); a literal command passed with an options value the source cannot read sits between the two.
open_points.input: `const o = { cwd: "/tmp" }` then `await sh("rm -rf d", o)` (equivalently `await sh("rm -rf d", { ...o })`)
outputs: `delete` — the command argument is a literal string, and options are outside the deletion face
`nonLiteral` — the call's argument object is not fixed by the source, as for every other launch argument object
open_points.searched: grep of the base checkout for `sh(` in eval-cell text (ci/, sandbox/scenarios/, docs/, agent/): the only cells naming a `sh` call are the contract's own probe texts and ci/tool-policy-nag-pty.test.ts:159 (`from os import system as sh`), none of which passes an options argument.

open_points.point: 决策 5 accepts a same-name local definition fail closed and does not track shadowing, and rules only the PyPI library's attribute spelling (`sh.rm(…)`) out; a cell that binds the name with `import sh` resolves to the very same qualified name `sh` (agent/extensions/_shared/eval-py-launches.ts:745-758 resolves `import sh` to module `sh`, :818-823 yields names `["sh"]`), so both readings remain open.
outputs: `delete` — the resolved qualified name is `sh`, and same-name definitions are judged as the helper fail closed
`allow` — the cell bound `sh` to a module, so the call is not the prelude helper (the reading the existing `from os import system as sh` fixture relies on)
open_points.searched: grep of the base checkout for `import sh` and `as sh`: the only binding of the name in cell text is ci/tool-policy-nag-pty.test.ts:159 (`from os import system as sh`), which resolves to `os.system` rather than `sh`; no doc, topic or sandbox scenario writes `import sh`.

gate_gaps.row: 验收标准 第 3 行 (结果 2, whose forms are enumerated "逐形态")
gate_gaps.input: `d = "d"` then `sh(f"rm -rf {d}")`; `c = "rm -rf d"` then `sh(command=c)`; `sh("rm -rf d", **{"timeout": 5})` — the driver feeds only the variable form `sh(cmd)`.

gate_gaps.row: 验收标准 第 6 行 (结果 5, which names `python3 -c`, `bun -e` and here-doc input)
gate_gaps.input: `bun -e 'await sh("rm -rf d")'` and `python3 - <<'EOF'` + `sh("rm -rf d")` + `EOF` through `guardToolCall("bash", …)` — the driver feeds only `python3 -c`.

gate_gaps.row: 验收标准 第 4 行 (结果 3, second half: unreadable calls pass the pty lane)
gate_gaps.input: `h = "x"` then `sh(f"ssh {h}")` (py) and `const h = "x"` then `await sh(h)` (js) must read `no-hit`; the driver feeds only the js `${}` template.

gate_gaps.row: 决策表第 7 行 (pty judges only direct spellings, alias fails open) and 第 5 行 (`globalThis.sh` is a counted js spelling)
gate_gaps.input: `const s = sh` then `await s("ssh host")`; `s = sh` then `s("ssh host")`; and `await globalThis.sh("ssh host")` which must read `passthrough` — none of the three is in the driver.

gate_gaps.row: 验收标准 第 4 行 / 结果 3 requirement that the refusal carries one `xd://exec_command` line
gate_gaps.input: `ptyRefusal(ptyEvalHit("py", 'sh("ssh target uptime")'), "eval")` — assert its two lines and that the second is exactly `xd://exec_command`; the driver reads only `hit.category` and scenario 8 asserts only `pty 路由`.

gate_gaps.row: 决策表第 5 行 (attribute spellings do not count; same-name local definitions are accepted fail closed)
gate_gaps.input: `self.sh("rm -rf d")`, `obj.sh("rm -rf d")`, `sh.rm("/tmp/x")` must read `allow`, and `def sh(c): …` then `sh("rm -rf d")` must read `delete`; no driver reading covers either direction.

gate_gaps.row: 决策表第 4 行 (js alias "或赋值")
gate_gaps.input: `s = sh` as a bare assignment in one js cell, then `await s("rm -rf d")` in the next; `jsAliasCarry` only feeds the `const s = sh` declaration.

gate_gaps.row: 验收标准 第 5 行 / 结果 4 ("`Bun.$` 的插值规则本身不改")
gate_gaps.input: `const d = 'd'` then `` await Bun.$`rm -rf ${d}` `` must stay `nonLiteral`; the driver feeds only the non-interpolated `keepBunDollar`.

gate_gaps.row: 范围边界 不应残留 (coverage lists in `delete-guard/index.ts`, `tool-policy-nag/pty.ts` headers and both `docs/extensions*.md`, and no page calling `sh` commands a platform shell)
gate_gaps.input: read the EVAL paragraphs of those two headers and the two doc twins, and grep them for `sh`; `bun run check` (biome includes only `agent/**/*.ts`, `ci/**/*.ts`, `sandbox/**/*.ts` per biome.json) and `bun run test` observe none of that text.
